title: Radar catchup prep — Raman Gupta — Jun 07 2027
content:
Context: quick, informal prep for Raman's weekly catch-up. He moved from core runtime to a hybrid perf/owner role last quarter; goal for this meeting is to check progress on the latency radar spike, unblock the infra dependency, align on career growth ladder + mentoring time, and confirm MITs for the next sprint.

Meeting meta:
- Duration: 30 min (aim for 25)
- Tone: pragmatic, coach-first, surface impediments, decide small next steps
- Outcome targets: 1) unblock INFRA-1123 if possible, 2) agree on 2 concrete mentor pairings, 3) MIT list for next sprint

Agenda (flow):
1) Quick personal check-in (2-3m)
   - How are you feeling about workload and time for learning?
2) Status on latency radar spike (8-10m)
   - What did we learn from the microbench runs? (ask for numbers: p50/p95 change)
   - Current blockers: infra throttling on long seq jobs (INFRA-1123), missing kernel perf counters on dedicated pool
   - Which experiments need more runway vs which we can shelve?
3) Ownership & deliveries (8m)
   - PR review load: PR #614 needs a rebase + perf check (assign reviewers)
   - Can Raman own rollout checklist for the canary? (short list of rollout steps I expect)
4) Growth / mentoring (4-5m)
   - Interest in being IC3->IC4 stretch: focus areas (system design + cross-team influence)
   - Two proposed mentors: Priyanka (platform infra) and Evan (quantization path). Ask Raman which he prefers to pair with this sprint.
5) Quick wrap & action items (2m)

Prep notes / questions to ask Raman:
- Show me the microbench delta slide (p50/p95) — expect concise numbers. If he doesn't have numbers, call out expected short-term experiments to generate them.
- Infra dependency: what exactly is blocking INFRA-1123? (need to know if it's policy, capacity, or missing logging hooks). If it is capacity, suggest we escalate to Rajiv/SRE today.
- PR #614: is it blocking any downstream work or just clean-up? If blocking, do we allocate pairing time to merge this week?
- Mentoring: what does success look like in 8 weeks? (specific measurable goals: own one rollout, present a postmortem, lead a cross-team sync)
- Time budget: how many hours/week for deep work vs meetings? Are meetings creeping >30%?

Notes to self (manager):
- Keep tone light; avoid turning this into a performance review. Focus on concrete support.
- If Raman asks for headcount or capacity, tell him I'll surface to product/infra with a one-paragraph ask + impact statement.
- If INFRA-1123 is a capacity issue, route to Rajiv and CC product PM (Lina) with short summary.

Raman's likely status recap (based on async updates):
- Completed: baseline microbench harness, initial KV-cache experiment, draft PR #614
- In progress: stress testing with long context (failing due to instance OOMs on dedicated pool)
- Blocked: infra perf counters + quota bump (INFRA-1123)

Action items (explicit) — assign owners and due dates:
- A1: Raman — attach microbench artifacts to PR #614 and post a 1-paragraph summary in the PR description (due: 2027-06-09)
- A2: Asha (me) — escalate INFRA-1123 to Rajiv and request a capacity/priority decision; include short impact blurb for product (due: 2027-06-08)
- A3: Rajiv/SRE — check quota bump and perf counter availability (blocked -> unblock by 2027-06-11)
- A4: Raman + Priyanka/Evan — set two 1-hr pairing sessions this sprint for system design review and perf tooling (schedule by 2027-06-10)
- A5: Raman — prepare a 5-slide postmortem (or lit notes) on the latency radar experiments, focusing on what changed and next experiments (due: 2027-06-21)

Stretch asks / optional:
- Can Raman draft a short doc (1 page) proposing a lightweight sampling of model sizes across the dedicated pool to get representative perf numbers? This would help Optimize recommendations. If yes, offer to be reviewer.

Follow-up cadence:
- Quick async update by Raman in Slack channel #eng-latency with a short TL;DR if INFRA-1123 moves or PR #614 progresses (expected within 48 hours).
- Next 1:1: 2027-06-14 — focus on rollout readiness + mentoring feedback.

Raw snippets for the meeting (copy-paste friendly):
- "Can you give me the microbench p50/p95 numbers in one sentence?"
- "What's the single blocker that's stopping the stress run from completing? If it's a quota/capacity ask, I'll escalate now."
- "Which one thing would you like me to clear so you can make the biggest progress this week?"

Risks I should call out if we don't unblock quickly:
- longer signal/feedback loop will skew experiments and increase cost of chasing false leads
- team morale: Raman is excited about ownership; friction with infra could cause deferral to other tasks

Post-meeting: quick email template to Raman (send right after 1:1)
Subject: Recap: latency radar + next steps
Body: short bullets: A1 (attach artifacts), A2 (I escalated INFRA-1123), meeting notes link, calendar invites for pairing. Ask Raman to mark done on A1 and ping me in Slack when done.

Personal TODO (manager housekeeping):
- Draft escalation note to Rajiv (keep under 5 bullet points: symptom, impact, ask, owner, deadline)
- Add Raman's pairing sessions to my calendar as tentative hold
- Follow up on PR #614 reviewers (nudge Evan and Priyanka if not assigned by EOD)

End of prep. Keep the meeting focused on removing 1-2 concrete blockers; aim to leave with a clear, short list of who does what and when.

— Asha
summary: Manager scratchpad for Raman's 1:1 focusing on latency radar, infra unblock, PR #614, and mentoring. Contains agenda, questions, and explicit action items with due dates.
